levels.1: The selected route uses the original amusement hardware.
levels.2: Use an authentic 2015 Enterrise cabinet.
levels.3: Verify model plate, cabinet shell, reels, Movision, controls, lighting, firmware, and service record before capture. Do not substitute a later machine or an unidentified conversion.

levels.1: A mobile port preserved the machine presentation.
levels.2: Archive the original iOS package separately from cabinet evidence.
levels.3: Record package identifier, version, device, operating system, controls, available modes, audiovisual differences, saves, and service response. Use it only to supplement missing footage until feature parity is proven.

levels.1: A service-linked iOS release also existed.
levels.2: Keep the GREE build separate from the standalone package.
levels.3: Preserve application metadata, account state, service response, content menus, controls, save data, and comparison footage. Do not merge its records without direct parity evidence.

levels.1: An Android service is no longer normally available.
levels.2: Treat Android-only state as archival evidence.
levels.3: Preserve lawful packages, compatible device data, account remnants, shutdown response, menus, controls, saves, and dated recordings. Do not claim current availability.

levels.1: Completion never requires wagering.
levels.2: Use a lawfully owned cabinet configured for non-wager free play.
levels.3: Have an authorized owner follow the operator documentation. Do not deposit money, seek payouts, bypass safety hardware, or use public gambling to trigger rare content.

levels.1: Reels, Movision, main display, controls, lights, and audio act together.
levels.2: Record the entire cabinet continuously.
